rows.grounds: genitive plural of vanastha, recipients of the declaration
past passive participle serving as predicate
compound brahma-vādin in genitive plural, qualifying vanasthānāṃ

items.question: For which group of practitioners is this ritual observance declared?
premises: The preceding verses describe a ritual procedure of washing and offering.
This procedure is declared for forest-dwellers.
These forest-dwellers are characterized as speakers of brahman.
items.inference: The described ritual observance is prescribed specifically for forest-dwelling speakers of brahman.
uncertainties: The exact scope of the ritual referred to depends on the preceding verses.
items.plain_english: Indeed, this is declared for forest-dwellers who are speakers of Brahman.
